Rct3pp.LandShapeHelp: Raise or lower terrain: drag up or down
Rct3pp.WaterRefused: Water can only go on land the park owns, away from paths, and not under a higher lake.
Rct3pp.PartyLeader: Leads the party: chooses where they all go
Rct3pp.MendPathItemsHelp: Mend benches, bins and signs that vandals have broken, at no cost
Rct3pp.ReplaceBrokenHelp: Put every broken bench, bin and sign back new at once, paying the full price of each
Rct3pp.BorrowHelp: Borrow more, a step at a time, up to the maximum loan
Rct3pp.RepayHelp: Pay back a step of the loan from the cash in hand
Rct3pp.LoadingWarnings: Warnings so far: {count} (the log has them)
Rct3pp.PatrolUncovered: Paths no one in this job patrols:
Rct3pp.KeysTip: Click, then press the keys: F1 to F12, Escape, Enter, Tab, Page Up, Page Down or Insert, with Ctrl or Shift if wanted, or Ctrl with a letter or digit. Escape alone keeps the keys.
Rct3pp.CloudsHelp: Clouds drift across the sky above the park.
Rct3pp.SkyHelp: The sky shows the colours of the time of day, with the sun, the moon and the stars.
Rct3pp.MountainsHelp: Hills and mountains stand far beyond the edges of the park.
Rct3pp.BlendShadowsHelp: Shadows move smoothly as the sun crosses the sky, rather than in small steps. Costs a little more to draw.
Rct3pp.SurfaceDetailHelp: Grain gives textures fine detail up close, where they would look blurred, at almost no cost. Grain and relief also makes height from the light and dark of each texture, so brick, rock and paths catch the sun near the camera; it costs more to draw and takes effect when a park is loaded.
Rct3pp.TextureDetailHelp: How sharp the park's textures are. Lower uses smaller textures, which take less memory to draw. Takes effect when a park is loaded.
Rct3pp.RenderScaleHelp: How many pixels the game draws, as a share of the window's, stretched to fill it. Below 100 is faster and softer; above 100 is sharper and slower.
Rct3pp.SmoothScalingHelp: When the render scale is not 100, blend neighbouring pixels as the picture is stretched to the window. Off, each pixel shows as a sharp block.
Rct3pp.AmbientOcclusionHelp: Creases, corners and the ground under things are darker where less of the sky reaches them. Costs a little more to draw.
Rct3pp.ParticleBudgetHelp: The most fire, smoke and spray particles alive at once. Effects nearest the camera run first; the rest wait. 0 shows none.
Rct3pp.DisableWeatherHelp: Tick to keep the weather as it is now: no new forecasts, no change in the temperature or the wind.
Rct3pp.LightShaftsHelp: Sunlight shows in the air as a soft haze, cut into rays by the shadows of trees, rides and buildings.
Rct3pp.DetailBlendBandHelp: How long the stretch is over which scenery blends from one level of detail to the next as the camera moves. All the way down, scenery switches at once.
Rct3pp.AllItemsShown: All shown: the park does not say which are available
Rct3pp.TurnItemLeft: Turn the item being placed counterclockwise
Rct3pp.TurnItemRight: Turn the item being placed clockwise

Paths.NotOwned: The park does not own this
Paths.OffMap: Off the edge of the park
Paths.Occupied: Another path is in the way
Paths.RouteHelp: Route: point at a tile and the path finds its own way there from the arrow
Paths.StraightHelp: Straight: routes keep to the line to the tile pointed at, stepping along it, rather than turning once
Paths.RemoveHelp: Remove: click a path to take it away, or drag over paths; refunds what laying them costs

View.MoneyHelp: Show money spent and paid back floating up where it happens
View.GuestPaymentsHelp: Show what guests pay at rides and stalls floating up from their entrances
